extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians specializing in arithmetic geometry, anabelian geometry, and Mochizuki's inter-universal Teichmüller (IUT) theory
extracted.subtask_description: Advanced research exposition developing constructions and structural results about Frobenioids, F-/D-prime-strips, Kummer structures, NF-bridges, Θ-bridges, and related functorial/isomorphism statements in the context of Inter‑Universal Teichmüller Theory (IUT). Contains definitions, examples, corollaries, and algorithms (functorial constructions) used in the theory.
